title: On Highlighting the danger in red ink
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：highlight　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 highlight 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the elder ① highlighted the danger in red ink with great care, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② highlights the danger in red ink on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ highlight the danger in red ink at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ highlighted the danger in red ink before — a line in the memoir for November 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Highlighting the danger in red ink with great care, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ highlight the third paragraph on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Highlight the third paragraph at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ highlights the third paragraph with great care every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ highlighted the danger in red ink again when nobody else would.

⑩ To highlight the danger in red ink, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody highlights the danger in red ink on the same day again and somebody must highlight the danger in red ink with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 标出（一般过去式 highlighted the danger in red ink：1948 年长者头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 标出（一般现在 highlights the danger in red ink：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 标出（不定式 to highlight the danger in red ink：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 标出（过去完成时 had highlighted the danger in red ink：1942 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 标出（动名词 highlighting the danger in red ink 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 着重（highlight the third paragraph：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去着重把第三段着重讲一讲）
G. v. 着重（highlight the third paragraph：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 标出（后段两处：新来的后生照例 highlights the third paragraph，而母亲又一次 highlighted the danger in red ink）

items.q: highlighted the danger in red ink
highlights the danger in red ink
to highlight the danger in red ink
highlighted the danger in red ink before

answers.why: highlight 意为“标出”，1948 年长者小心翼翼地标出用红笔把危险处标出来，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 highlighted。
highlight 意为“标出”，自那以后长者当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 highlights。
highlight 意为“标出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯标出用红笔把危险处标出来”，此处为不定式 to highlight the danger in red ink。
highlight 意为“标出”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人标出过，故用过去完成时 had highlighted。
highlight 意为“标出”，长者说“标出用红笔把危险处标出来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 highlighting the danger in red ink 作主语。
highlight 意为“着重”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去着重把第三段着重讲一讲”，should ever 之后用原形 highlight the third paragraph。
highlight 意为“着重”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻着重把第三段着重讲一讲（highlight the third paragraph at once），以后再也不要提起。
highlight 意为“标出”，新来的后生每个年头都照例着重把第三段着重讲一讲，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 highlights。
highlight 意为“标出”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地标出用红笔把危险处标出来，用一般过去式 highlighted 叙述。
highlight 意为“标出”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要标出用红笔把危险处标出来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，长者小心翼翼地标出用红笔把危险处标出来；村子里每一个后生都说这是头一回。（highlighted the danger in red ink）
多年以后，长者仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（highlights the danger in red ink）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯标出用红笔把危险处标出来这件事本身。（to highlight the danger in red ink）
早在 1942 年就有人标出用红笔把危险处标出来，十一月那天回忆录上的一行字就是证据。（had highlighted the danger in red ink）
长者说过，小心翼翼地标出用红笔把危险处标出来这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（highlighting the danger in red ink 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻着重把第三段着重讲一讲，以后再也不要提起。（highlight the third paragraph，祈使句）
answers: In 1948 the elder highlighted the danger in red ink with great care, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the elder still highlights the danger in red ink on the same day without being asked.
My mother said later that to highlight the danger in red ink at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had highlighted the danger in red ink long before 1955, and the line in the memoir for November proves it.
Highlighting the danger in red ink with great care, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 highlight 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the elder highlighted the danger in red ink with great care, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder highlights the danger in red ink on the same day whenever the village asks.
Highlighting the danger in red ink with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever highlight the third paragraph on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village highlights the third paragraph with great care every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother highlighted the danger in red ink again, and the village remembered that half.
